integrity: The foundational publication date and biological mechanism were checked against PubMed/JSTOR and a curated model repository. The exact five equations were checked in a complete open mathematical article on the Goldbeter model. That article was searched for invariant-measure, average, and relevant variance statements. A same-object averaging paper was compared from its abstract and mathematical classification metadata. The five conditional flux laws, endpoint rigidity, and memory formula were reconstructed independently and the residual-variance algebra was replayed with the packaged checker.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns compactly supported invariant probability measures in the nonnegative concentration orthant.
Only the transcription and nuclear-transport endpoint defects are asserted to have equilibrium-only equality.
The result does not determine period, phase lag, bifurcation range, or the full invariant density.
The original 1995 article was not securely available as readable full text in the inspected route.
A differently phrased conditional flux statement could remain in unindexed biochemical-oscillator literature.
title: Exact stationary flux calibrations and nuclear-transport rigidity in Goldbeter's circadian clock
